gap: No result ChatGPT got states that each maker's headline battery figure assumes the backlight is off, or that turning it on cuts it 6 to 20 times: Keychron Q1 Max drops from 180 h to 30 h (lowest RGB), Lofree Flow 2 from 120 h to 14 h (maximum backlight) and Logitech MX Mechanical Mini from 10 months to 15 days. NuPhy's 1,200 h for the Air75 V3 is a lights-off figure from a 4,000 mAh battery, the same capacity behind Keychron's 180 h.
standout_why: ChatGPT's answer never mentions battery life. RTINGS 'Best Keyboards For Typing' (cited) and Tom's Guide 'best mechanical keyboards' (cited) both returned only navigation and no article body when fetched on 2026-11-17, so I could not confirm that neither has lit-versus-unlit figures. That is why this is scored 2 and not 3. Our current page lists only the lights-off figures (Lofree 120 h, Keychron 180 h), says 'Not stated' for Logitech and 'Not verified' for NuPhy, so the rebuilt page would be the first to put all four on the same lit and unlit basis.
decides: This confirms the pick and doesn't change it. Someone who types with the backlight on gets about 30 h from the Keychron Q1 Max and about 14 h at full brightness from the Lofree Flow 2, which means charging every few days or every couple of days, not weekly. Logitech's 15 days lit is the longest lit claim sourced here, so it is the best of these for backlit typing away from a cable. Without a NuPhy lit figure, the Air75 V3's 1,200 h can't be weighed against the others, and the page shouldn't present it as 7× the Keychron.

findings.label: Battery life, backlight off vs RGB on
findings.value: Up to 180 h backlight off; up to 30 h RGB on at lowest brightness; 4,000 mAh
findings.source_title: Keychron Q1 Max Keyboard Review – KitGuru (Mat Mynett)
findings.note: KitGuru reprints Keychron's spec table: 'Up to 180 hours (Lab test result may vary by actual use)' and 'Up to 30 hours (Lowest brightness)'. Lit is 1/6 of unlit, and that is at the lowest brightness. Keychron's own page returned HTTP 429, so this is the named-reviewer fallback. KitGuru measured no battery life itself.

findings.product: Lofree Flow 2 (100-key; same 3,000 mAh cell as the 84)
findings.label: Battery life, normal vs maximum backlight
findings.value: About 120 h active use; up to 14 h at maximum backlight brightness; 3,000 mAh
findings.note: Reviewed unit is the Flow 2 100. Lit is 14/120, about 1/8.6. In Inghe's test the charge fell 20% over three days on Bluetooth, and he calls the battery life 'mediocre'. Applying this to the 84 assumes the same 3,000 mAh cell and backlight, which our page lists.

findings.label: Battery life, backlight on vs off
findings.value: Up to 15 days on a full charge; up to 10 months with backlighting off
findings.source_title: MX Mechanical Mini for Mac – Logitech (Singapore store)
findings.note: Quoted: 'stays powered up to 15 days on a full charge – or up to 10 months with backlighting turned off.' The US page loads its specs with script and showed no battery text. The Mac and PC versions share the hardware. Lit is about 15/300 days, roughly 1/20. The backlight turns on when hands come near, which is why the lit figure lasts so long.

findings.label: Battery life, RGB off
findings.value: Up to 1,200 h with RGB off; 4,000 mAh; about 5 h to recharge
findings.source_title: NuPhy Air V2/V3 series – NuPhy blog
findings.note: This NuPhy page gives no RGB-on figure. Arithmetic: 1,200 h ÷ 4 Ah = 300 h per Ah, against Keychron's 180 h ÷ 4 Ah = 45 h per Ah on the same capacity. The 6.7× gap points to different test conditions, not a better battery. Product page returned HTTP 429.
